stemBlocks: A shopper pushes a supermarket trolley a distance of $15 \text{ m}$ in a straight line across a level, horizontal surface. The shopper applies a constant force of $50 \text{ N}$ at an angle of $37^{\circ}$ below the horizontal. The total weight of the trolley and its contents is $350 \text{ N}$.
What is the magnitude of the total vertical force that the surface exerts on the trolley and how much work is done by the pushing force?
